# Changelog

## [v0.1.2] - 2026-11-15
### Added
- Added analyze_mask to return read-only mask, skeleton, radius, confidence, and graph data
- Added deterministic edge-covering walks for connected graphs, with endpoint control, edge directions, and repeat counts
- Added endpoint-tangent scoring and optional hard constraints to route ranking and orientation ambiguity analysis

## [v0.1.1] - 2026-11-14
### Added
- Added skeleton-only graph construction, optional mask processing, and ranked route selections with ambiguity metadata

### Documentation
- Documented graph construction, route selection, ranking, ambiguity, limits, and PlanarCurve interoperability

## [0.1.0] - 2026-11-13
### Added
- Added graph construction from binary masks or skeletons, spur pruning, and topology-aware route ranking and selection
- Added mask radius, component filtering, bounded route inventories, score and ambiguity metadata, and PlanarCurve metrics

### Changed
- Changed package metadata to support scikit-image 0.25.2
